ruling.author: velvetmonkey
ruling.scope: PR 252 changes NO protected artifact. Its only file is test/release-publish-gate.test.cjs, which is not a protected path. ALL FIVE artifacts reported below are BYTE-IDENTICAL to origin/main; I compared every blob myself before writing this record. They appear only because the branch was brought up to date with a MERGE commit, and the checker walks every commit with `git log -m`, which diffs a merge against EVERY parent. So each file main gained since the branch diverged is reported as changed even though the net diff is zero. THE LESSON, recorded so it is not repeated: bring a branch up to date with `gh pr update-branch --rebase` BEFORE any merge commit exists. Once a merge commit is present, --rebase reports 'already up-to-date' and does nothing, and a ruling becomes the only non-destructive way forward. WHAT 252 ACTUALLY DOES: test/release-publish-gate.test.cjs reached api.github.com from inside the product suite, so a rate limit or a dropped connection reported the SAME result as a misconfigured repository. It failed four times on 2026-09-06, each time with Node 20 and Node 22 disagreeing on an identical tree. This separates the two outcomes. grok-4.6 frisked fable CROSS-FAMILY: wrong-config-cases 7, wrong-config-all-failed yes, undetermined-set-too-wide no, lines-deleted 6, other-tests-touched 0.
